entries.title: Psalms 111:1
segments: ¶Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with [my] whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and [in] the congregation. {Praise ye...: Heb. Hallelujah}

entries.title: Psalms 111:2
segments: The works of the LORD [are] great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

words.text: of all them that have pleasure

entries.title: Psalms 111:3
segments: His work [is] honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 111:4
segments: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD [is] gracious and full of compassion.

entries.title: Psalms 111:5
segments: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant. {meat: Heb. prey}

entries.title: Psalms 111:6
segments: ¶He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

entries.title: Psalms 111:7
segments: The works of his hands [are] verity and judgment; all his commandments [are] sure.

entries.title: Psalms 111:8
segments: They stand fast for ever and ever, [and are] done in truth and uprightness. {stand...: Heb. are established}

entries.title: Psalms 111:9
segments: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend [is] his name.

entries.title: Psalms 111:10
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do [his commandments]: his praise endureth for ever. {a good...: or, good success} {his commandments: Heb. them}

words.text: . {a good...: or, good success} {his commandments: Heb. them}
